title: 18. Vials, Tubes, and Billion-Dollar Niches w/Jon aka. Borlaug

reader_summary.headline: Welcome to yet another episode of the Best Anchor Stocks Podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Welcome to yet another episode of the Best Anchor Stocks Podcast. This time I was very lucky to be joined by John, aka Borlaug and founder of the Borlaug Report. John knows a lot about the life sciences industry, so that's where we decided to focus the conversation on.

key_points.text: The industry has gone through a rough patch post-COVID that has coincided with all the uncertainty related to the change in administration in the US..

thesis: The podcast episode introduces John Borlaug, founder of the Borlaug Report, who focuses on the life sciences industry rather than pharmaceutical or biotech companies. The discussion highlights that while the healthcare sector faces post-COVID uncertainty and political changes, it remains attractive long-term due to secular drivers like population aging and chronic disease, with a specific focus on the fill-and-finish niche.
